title: Chandrakanta Vidyalankar Smriti Grantha: Life, Lexicography and Historical Studies
author: Rajanikanta Dev Sarma (Editor)
description: Scholarly commemorative volume published by Nalbari Sahitya Sabha honoring Mahamahopadhyaya Chandrakanta Vidyalankar. It presents authoritative research papers on the compilation of the seminal Chandrakanta Abhidhan dictionary, Tai-Ahom lexical loans, manuscript decipherment, and the history of indigenous printing in Assam.
